metadonnees.description: AI model catalog and API key requests

accueil.presentation: This portal gives access to Linagora's AI models through an OpenAI-compatible API. Each API key is approved by an administrator and limited to the models compatible with the confidentiality level of your data.

succes.adhesionApprouvee: Membership approved: the requester has been added to the team.
succes.complementDemande: Request sent back to the requester for more information.

erreurs.controles_en_echec: The request does not comply with the model access policy. Failed checks: {controles}.
erreurs.deja_membre: You are already a member of the {equipe} team.
erreurs.engagement_requis: Commit to not submitting data above the declared level.
erreurs.introuvable: {objet, select, modele {Model {modele} is not declared in the gateway.} equipe {Team not found.} demande_adhesion {Membership request not found.} demande_cle {Key request not found.} other {Request not found.}}
erreurs.parametre_manquant: Budget, budget period and validity are required: enter them or configure default values.
erreurs.recommandation_hors_cas_usage: A recommendation can only apply to a checked use case.
erreurs.tarif_eur_manquant: Model {modele} has no price in euros: it cannot be made visible.
erreurs.transition_interdite: {cas, select, modifiee {The request was modified in the meantime; reload the page.} traitee {This request has already been processed.} other {This action is not possible in the current status of the request.}}

controles.membre_equipe: The requester is a member of the team
controles.modeles_presents: At least one model is requested
controles.modeles_equipe: The models are allowed for the team
controles.niveau_modeles: The models accept the declared confidentiality level
controles.modeles_visibles: The models are visible in the catalog

gestionCatalogue.introduction: Each model declared in the gateway gets its sheet here: texts in French (required, except limitations) and in English (optional, French is shown instead), use cases and recommendations. Technical facts come from the gateway.
gestionCatalogue.sansTarif: No price in euros: this model cannot be made visible.
gestionCatalogue.aucunModele: No model is declared in the gateway.
